title: FWFS E04 Part 04 · Saturday Morning — The Kiss Aftermath

source.adapted_plot_function: Next-morning reflection on Friday kiss, her own participation, uncertainty about infidelity, and not telling her husband.

continuity: Chirag is 22, not the original source teenager
Friday was his confirmed return day
Ritvik remains uninformed of the kiss
Karan and Aman are adult colleagues, not the DHIKA teenage tuition students
Monday after-work freelance review agreed on Thursday

lines.text: Saturday morning, Bansal Apartment. Bathroom ke sheeshe par halki bhaap thi. Ankita ne nal band kiya, lekin kal Friday ka ek pal uske dimaag se nahi gaya — Chirag ka achanak paas aana, chhota sa kiss, aur uska apne aap jawaab de dena.

Usne aankhen band kar li. Sab kuch itni jaldi hua tha ki us waqt samajhne ka mauka nahi mila. Lekin ab, ek raat baad, woh us moment ko baar-baar usi jagah se yaad kar rahi thi jahan dono ekdum chup ho gaye the.
*Main peeche kyun nahi hati?* Usne khud se poochha. Agla sawaal zyada mushkil tha. *Aur maine use rokne ke bajay kiss wapas kyun kiya?*
Woh sirf Chirag ko blame karke baat khatam nahi kar sakti thi. Woh 22 saal ka adult tha, aur Ankita bhi apni choices ki zimmedar thi. Friday ki ghabrahat ke beech yeh baat usse ab saaf dikh rahi thi.

Chirag ka darra hua chehra bhi yaad aaya — uske turant peeche hatne ka tareeka, phir Ankita ka jaldi se bedroom ki taraf chala jaana. Jaane se pehle usne jo kaha tha, usse yaad karke woh aur sharma gayi: *I liked it.*

*Kya main sach mein kehna chahti thi?* Use laga jawab haan tha. Isi wajah se uske andar ek halka sa darr bhi uth raha tha. Jo baat kal bas kuch seconds ki thi, uska matlab aaj zyada bada lag raha tha.
Usne towel achchhe se fold kiya, jaise ek bilkul ordinary kaam use wapas routine mein la sakta ho. Lekin towel rakhne ke baad bhi uske khayal wahi the.

Tuesday ka documents wala encounter yaad aaya. Us din usne Chirag ka reaction samajhne ki koshish ki thi. Friday ko shelf ke paas jo hua, woh shuru mein normal kaam tha; phir nazron aur teasing ne dono ko ek alag hi mood mein la diya.
*Toh kya kal ka kiss wahi sab ka continuation tha?* Ankita abhi is sawaal ka pakka jawab nahi de sakti thi. Chirag ne us moment ko kaise samjha hoga, yeh bhi usse pata nahi tha.

Bahar ghar ki roz ki awaazein aa rahi thi. Ankita ne darwaza khola aur ek pal ke liye ruk gayi. Uska ghar, uski shaadi, Rey ki chhoti-chhoti baatein — kuch bhi badla hua nahi lag raha tha. Badli hui cheez uske andar thi.
Ritvik ko Friday ki delivery ka pata hona koi badi baat nahi thi. Lekin us delivery ke baad kya hua, uske baare mein Ankita ne ek shabd bhi nahi kaha tha.
*Kya yeh cheating hai?* Sawaal aaya, aur Ankita ne turant use dabaane ki koshish ki. Phir bhi use laga ki kisi cheez ko naam na dene se woh cheez gayab nahi ho jaati.
Usne khud ko yaad dilaya ki Chirag ne uski taraf dekha, woh uske saath hansi, aur kal ke aakhri pal mein woh bhi us kiss mein shaamil thi. Yeh ek one-sided incident ki simple kahani nahi thi.

Woh Ritvik ke saamne abhi is baat ko rakhne ke liye ready nahi thi. Iska matlab yeh nahi tha ki usne apne aap ko poori tarah maaf kar diya tha. Bas woh us subah confession ya explanation dono se bach rahi thi.
Phone uthaya toh screen par normal notifications thi. Chirag ka koi message nahi. Ankita ne bina kuch type kiye phone wapas rakh diya. Koi nayi baat shuru karne ka faisla usne nahi kiya.

Thursday ko Karan aur Aman ke saamne jo embarrassing accident hua tha, woh bhi use yaad aaya. Monday shaam un dono ke saath freelance-project ka pehla proper review planned tha. Ab woh meeting ek aur wajah se awkward lag rahi thi.
lines.source_type: FWFS PRIOR CANON / NEXT ENCOUNTER BRIDGE

lines.text: Usne schedule yaad kiya — Monday, office ke baad, ek ghante ki project discussion. Karan usually aasan tareeke se baat sambhaal leta tha. Aman zyada chup rehta tha. Dono ka Thursday ko alag-alag reaction uske dimaag mein abhi bhi fresh tha.
lines.source_type: FWFS PRIOR CANON / NEXT ENCOUNTER BRIDGE

lines.text: *Main normal behave kar paungi?* Is baar sawaal Chirag ke baare mein nahi, un dono colleagues ke baare mein tha. Ankita ne apne aap ko kaha ki kaam ka kaam alag hai, aur personal embarrassment ko us par haavi nahi hone dena chahiye.
lines.source_type: FWFS PRIOR CANON / NEXT ENCOUNTER BRIDGE

lines.text: Woh kitchen ki taraf badhi. Abhi Saturday tha. Monday ki meeting aur Friday ki memory ke beech poora weekend pada tha, aur filhaal use apne ghar ki morning routine sambhaalni thi.
lines.source_type: FWFS PRIOR CANON / NEXT ENCOUNTER BRIDGE

lines.text: Lekin breakfast ki taiyaari karte hue bhi ek baat uske saath rahi: kal Chirag ke saamne woh apni reaction se khud surprised thi. Agli baar usse milne par kya kahegi, abhi use nahi pata tha.
lines.source_type: FWFS PRIOR CANON / NEXT ENCOUNTER BRIDGE

lines.text: Usne apne khayalon ko ek taraf rakha aur routine mein laut aayi. Ritvik ko kiss ke baare mein kuch nahi bataya. Friday ka woh chhota sa raaz Saturday subah bhi uske paas hi raha.
lines.source_type: FWFS PRIOR CANON / NEXT ENCOUNTER BRIDGE

note: Source has two narrative lines; this expansion does not claim 21-to-2 strict textual equivalence. It retains the source core while bridging FWFS adult colleagues' Monday return.
